propositions: A plan edited mid-review runs every remaining LLM pass and only fails at sign time when own material differs, wasting all billed work after the edit.

The mid-run cancel predicate must be scoped to OWN material only, not tracker HEAD, relation snapshot, or related material, to avoid reintroducing the d70a false-cancel regression on unrelated tickets' writes.

The cancel signal must be an out-of-band token checked by produce_plan_review_verdict before its coach/verify recovery paths, since a step failure would otherwise be recovered into a findings verdict.
Cancellation probes are placed at exactly two between-pass seams (verify_inputs and coach_inputs), skipping downstream verify/coach prompt steps.
A cancelled review returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with no signature and no sidecar write, mapping to CLI exit code 2.
The cancel path is fail-open and monotone: an unknown or None fingerprint read does not cancel and degrades to today's sign-time refusal, never minting an attestation.
